variants.label: PI30 MAX 6200W raw-ASCII runtime over EyeBond AT collector

notes: Issue #27 support evidence detects the inverter at high confidence through the built-in PI30 MAX runtime.
QPI reports PI30, QMN reports the generic raw model VMII-NXPW5KW, and QPIRI reports a 6200 W / 48 V 28-field rating.

known_limitations: The inverter identity command reports the generic raw model VMII-NXPW5KW rather than the commercial Yingfa model name.
Writable controls were exposed by the runtime but were not independently exercised in the attached support archive.
knowledge_summary: Yingfa YF6.2K-LEL-1B support is confirmed by the issue #27 support archive. The inverter uses the existing PI30 MAX profile over an EyeBond AT-text collector and provides valid rating, live telemetry, warning, mode, and firmware responses.
